mapper.select: SELECT pr.status, pr.version, po.id AS purchase_order_id, po.ordered_at FROM purchase_requests pr LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.request_id = pr.id WHERE pr.id = #{requestId} AND pr.status IN ('APPROVED', 'ORDERED', 'COMPLETED')
SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE id = #{supplierId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_requests SET status = #{nextStatus}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_orders (id, request_id, actual_supplier_id, actual_supplier_name_snapshot, purchase_order_number, promised_delivery_date, purchaser_note, ordered_by, ordered_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{orderNumber}, #{promisedDate}, #{note}, #{orderedBy}, #{orderedAt})

INSERT INTO purchase_order_items (id, purchase_order_id, request_item_id, actual_unit_price) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{item.requestItemId}, #{item.actualUnitPrice})

INSERT INTO request_receipts (id, purchase_order_id, received_date, receipt_note, received_by, completed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{receivedDate}, #{note}, #{receivedBy}, #{completedAt})
